title: Oath of Breaking the Game
next_chapter_hook: As soon as Chen Ji's words fell, a cold snort that shattered the heavens came from the nine heavens above—it was the fury of the Heavenly Eye, and the beginning of the collapse of the fate chess game.

text.content: That eerie light seeped from the depths of the fragment, like ancient eyes sleeping for millennia suddenly opening. Chen Ji felt an indescribable pressure surging from all directions, and the air in the entire great hall trembled and twisted under this force. He stared intently at the fragment in his hand, his pupils reflecting countless intertwined light patterns—not ordinary spiritual fluctuations, but something transcending cognition was awakening.

In the void, a figure slowly materialized. It was an existence impossible to discern, its form cloaked in an aura interweaving chaos and order, as if it had existed between heaven and earth since time immemorial. Gazing down at Chen Ji with contempt, its voice thundered like countless bolts of lightning exploding beside his ears: "Chen Ji, you dare to make a choice before me?" The First Observer—the projection of the Heavenly Eye—had finally revealed itself.

dialogue.content: "'Waste'? Hmph, this one has been observing you for quite some time. Every scheme, every moment of forbearance—none have escaped my gaze. Today is the time to make a choice—become this one's chess piece, or... be utterly annihilated."

text.content: Chen Ji slowly straightened his body. Even though the pressure bore down on him like a mountain of ten thousand zhang, his spine remained perfectly straight. Waste? He curled his lips in mockery. Years of forbearance were not for such a high-and-mighty existence to define him. He took a deep breath, his voice terrifyingly calm: "Chess piece? This Chen Ji has only ever played his own chess."

choice.prompt: The Heavenly Eye descends four paths of destiny, and Chen Ji must make a choice:

choices.description: Accept the arrangement of the Heavenly Eye, become its agent, enjoy supreme power and eternal life, but at the cost of forever losing free will, becoming a true chess piece.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain authorization from Heaven, become Heaven's Agent
choices.risk_hint: Seemingly the optimal choice, actually a descent into eternal damnation

text.content: The first path manifested in the void, dazzling and magnificent like a deity descending to the mortal realm. The Heavenly Eye's voice carried seduction: "This is the optimal choice. You shall obtain all this one's power, henceforth gazing down upon all living beings, immortal and undying."

choices.description: Burn all Heavenly Fate Value and the power of the Tianji Record Fragment to declare war on the Heavenly Eye. Striking the stone with an egg, refusing to submit even unto death. Victory is extremely unlikely, but dignity can be preserved.
choices.visible_reward: Leave a name in history, shaking Heaven's authority
choices.risk_hint: The most tragic choice, victory probability almost zero

text.content: The second path was pitch black, emanating a violent aura of destruction. The Heavenly Eye snorted coldly: "Reckless fool! You think you can contend with Heaven with just the power of a fragment? How laughable!"

choices.description: Abandon the Tianji Record, sever all connections with Heaven, cultivate again as a mortal. No longer a prophet, just an ordinary person, far from all disputes.
choices.visible_reward: Completely free, no longer observed by any existence
choices.risk_hint: Seemingly gaining freedom, actually abandoning the chance to change fate

text.content: The third path glowed dimly, so ordinary it almost didn't exist. The Heavenly Eye seemed disdainful: "The choice of the mediocre. Should you choose this path, this one shall treat you as if you never existed."

choices.description: Neither submit, nor destroy, nor escape—break the shackles while transcending Heaven, creating a fourth kind of destiny that no one has ever walked.
choices.visible_reward: Reshape Heaven's rules, become a true variable
choices.risk_hint: A path no one has ever taken, success rate unknown

text.content: As Chen Ji fell into silence, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly trembled violently, and a line of text that had never appeared before surfaced—it was the fourth road, the possibility ignored by all observers. "This path..." The Heavenly Eye's voice rarely showed a fluctuation, "How could you know?"

Chen Ji raised his head, gazing directly at that Heavenly Eye that transcended all things. His voice was not loud but clear: "How could I know?" He smiled bitterly, "Because I am the chess piece you selected—the holder of the Tianji Record. For thousands of millions of years, how many prophets have made choices on these four roads? Those who submitted became puppets, those who destroyed themselves turned to dust, those who escaped remained nameless." He paused, a hint of madness flickering in his eyes, "But have you ever considered, what if someone refuses to walk any of these four roads?"

dialogue.content: I will not be your chess piece, not a prisoner of fate, nor a coward who transcends worldly affairs. I want—to break this chess game, to reshape this Heaven!

text.content: As his words fell, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly burst forth with blinding golden light. That radiance pierced through the great hall's dome, shooting straight into the clouds. The entire Tianqing Sect was shaken by this omen. The Heavenly Eye's projection twisted violently, and an expression of fury seemed to appear on that indiscernible face—for the first time in eons, an ant dared to challenge Heaven.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji's declaration shocked all present, but he needs practical action to prove his resolve:

choices.description: Pour all remaining Heavenly Fate into the Tianji Record to unlock power beyond current limitations. This is a move of burning one's bridges—success opens a new road, failure turns to ashes.
choices.visible_reward: Tianji Record evolves, unlocking the complete content of the fourth page
choices.risk_hint: Extremely high risk, but also the only chance to shake Heaven

text.content: Chen Ji felt the Heavenly Fate within him surge like boiling magma, every drop burning, every drop crying out. The text on the fragment began to reorganize, and the seal between the first and second pages was crumbling—

choices.description: Call upon Mo Xiansheng to intervene, using the wisdom of the Guardian of Residual Souls to find that road no one has ever walked. With Master as guide, perhaps a more stable method can be found.
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng may have reservations and may not assist with full strength

text.content: An ancient sigh echoed from the depths of the Tianji Record, and Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded: "Foolish child, you truly wish to walk this road?" That tone held worry, relief, and a barely perceptible anticipation. "Very well, since your resolve is set, this old one shall aid you once more—"

dialogue.content: "Enough!" The Heavenly Eye's voice was like the Heavenly Dao Laws themselves raging with fury, "You ant, actually dare to break the rules unchanged since antiquity! This one gives you one final chance—retract your earlier arrogance, submit to this one, or else..."

text.content: Chen Ji looked at that majestic figure, his heart holding not a shred of fear. These years of forbearance, Su Qingyao's sacrifice, his sister Chen Nian's disappearance—all of it gathered at this moment into a surging tide of hatred and resolve. He slowly shook his head, his voice calm yet firm: "Or else what? Turn to ashes?" He smiled bitterly, "I have already died once. What fear is there in dying once more?"

dialogue.content: I, Chen Ji, have borne the name of waste for over a decade, have been pushed around as your chess piece for over a decade. Today, I shall make this heaven and earth remember—waste can also overturn the heavens!

text.content: As Chen Ji's words fell, a cold snort that shattered the heavens came from the nine heavens above. It was not anger, but—contempt. The Heavenly Eye's voice sounded again, but with a strange smile: "Interesting... You are the first ant in ten million years to dare speak such words to this one." Its voice suddenly turned cold, "But this one wishes to see—how can this ant hiding in the shadows overturn the heavens!"

The Tianji Record Fragment suddenly trembled violently, and Chen Ji felt an unprecedented power surge forth from within it. It was not the power of the Heavenly Eye, but—his own power. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his mind, carrying a hint of excitement: "It worked! The fourth page... it has chosen you itself! Chen Ji, you now possess the possibility to break the shackles of fate—but this is not enough, you still need one thing."

Chen Ji did not hesitate, pouring all his spiritual power into the fragment. He felt the Tianji Record burning hot in his palm as if gripping a sun, and the never-before-manifest fourth page was slowly unfurling—on it there was no text, only a vague outline, as if waiting for him to fill it. Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded again: "The fourth road needs a key—find it, and you can truly break this chess game."

dialogue.content: "Key..." Chen Ji murmured, countless images flickering through his mind—Su Qingyao's resolve, Ye Qing's deal, the old Sect Master's hidden malicious intent, Han Lie's obsession, his sister Chen Nian's disappearance... all the clues connected at this moment, "So that's it! I understand!"

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes snapped open, brilliant light blazing from within. The Heavenly Eye seemed to sense something, its projection suddenly pressing closer: "You... discovered what?" Chen Ji did not answer, only laughing long and skyward. That laughter carried years of suppressed joy and madness: "So the so-called key has always been by my side! Heavenly Eye, you set this game for ten million years, today let this one end it!"

The fourth page of the Tianji Record suddenly burst forth with dazzling light, and that vague outline finally revealed its true form—it was an ancient key pattern, and in the key's center was engraved a name that shocked Chen Ji's very soul: Chen Nian. "Sister..." Chen Ji's entire body trembled. So searching for Chen Nian was not only his obsession but also the key to breaking fate. The Heavenly Eye's voice finally carried a hint of panic: "No! You cannot—!"

Chen Ji felt the information transmitted by the Tianji Record—Chen Nian being taken by the Holy Sect was no coincidence, but part of the Heavenly Eye's布局. She was the "Heavenly Fate Lock Key," the key to sealing the fourth page's power. Once Chen Nian returned to his side, the fourth page would completely awaken, and then... Chen Ji's lips curved into a cold smile as he looked at the furious Heavenly Eye: "You're afraid? The Heaven that has held the winning hand for ten million years can also be afraid of a waste?"

As the atmosphere grew tense, Chen Ji suddenly收敛气势. He knew this was not yet the time for direct confrontation with the Heavenly Eye—he needed to first find Chen Nian, needed more powerful strength, needed a more thorough layout. He took a deep breath and slightly cupped his hands toward the Heavenly Eye: "Today's words, this one has noted. Another day, they shall surely be returned." As his words fell, the Tianji Record's light收敛, and Chen Ji's figure slowly vanished in the shocked gazes of the crowd—that was the art of spatial displacement.
